headlines.title: 央行：继续实施适度宽松的货币政策
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议指出，继续实施适度宽松的货币政策。综合运用逆回购、中期借贷便利、买卖国债等多种货币政策工具，提供短、中、长期流动性，保持流动性充裕，引导金融机构大力支持实体经济有效融资需求。完善短端利率调控机制，增加隔夜逆回购操作品种，收窄临时隔夜正/逆回购操作利率区间。强化利率政策执行和监督，督促金融机构明示贷款综合融资成本，保持社会综合融资成本低位运行。做好市场沟通和预期引导。6月末，社会融资规模同比增长7.4%，广义货币供应量同比增长8.0%。坚持市场在汇率形成中起决定性作用，人民币汇率双向波动。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: To continue implementing a moderately loose monetary policy
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China held its 2026 H2 work conference. The meeting noted that it will continue a moderately loose monetary policy. Various monetary policy tools including reverse repos, medium-term lending facilities, and government bond trading will be comprehensively utilized to provide short-, medium-, and long-term liquidity, maintain ample liquidity, and guide financial institutions to strongly support the effective financing needs of the real economy. The short-end interest rate adjustment mechanism will be improved, overnight reverse repo operation varieties added, and the temporary overnight positive/reverse repo operation rate band narrowed. The execution and supervision of interest rate policies will be strengthened, urging financial institutions to clearly indicate comprehensive loan financing costs and keeping overall social financing costs low. Market communication and expectation guidance will be conducted. At end-June, aggregate social financing grew 7.4% year-on-year, and broad money supply rose 8.0% year-on-year. The market plays a decisive role in exchange rate formation, with the RMB exchange rate fluctuating in both directions.

headlines.title: 陈茂波：香港将上调全年经济增长预测
headlines.summary: 香港财政司司长陈茂波8月2日发表司长随笔称，本港今年上半年经济增长为5.1%，较预期强劲。下半年商品出口料继续受惠全球对人工智能产品的强大需求；境外对本港金融及商业服务的需求持续，以及访港旅客的增加，均将带动服务输出增长，有利本地消费和投资气氛。综合考虑整体经济发展情况，本月中发表的经修订全年经济增长预测，将从原先预测的范围向上调整，惟未来走势仍受地缘政治局势发展、美息及其他不确定因素影响。我们将继续保持高度警惕，既大力加快发展经济，也守稳经济金融安全。

headlines.title_en: Chan Mo-po: Hong Kong to raise full-year economic growth forecast
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan said in his blog on August 2 that Hong Kong's economy grew 5.1% in the first half of this year, stronger than expected. In H2, merchandise exports are expected to continue benefiting from strong global demand for AI products; sustained overseas demand for Hong Kong's financial and business services, along with rising visitor arrivals, will boost services export growth and support local consumption and investment sentiment. Considering overall economic developments, the revised annual growth forecast to be released mid-month will be adjusted upward from the original range, though the outlook remains subject to geopolitical developments, US interest rates, and other uncertainties. We will maintain heightened vigilance, both accelerating economic development and safeguarding economic and financial security.

headlines.title: 上半年全国二手房交易占比超新房
headlines.summary: 今年上半年，全国二手房交易占比超过新房，达到50.4%，传统以新房销售为主的增量交易格局正加快向新房和二手房并举转变，房地产市场进入存量时代。在中央经济工作会议“控增量、去库存、优供给”的要求下，多个城市也在通过多种方式盘活存量房源，推动既有住房资源的优化配置，激活存量住房价值。（央视财经）

headlines.title_en: Second-hand home transactions accounted for over half of total housing sales nationwide in first half
headlines.summary_en: In the first half of this year, national second-hand home transactions accounted for over 50.4% of total housing transactions, surpassing new homes, and the traditional incremental transaction pattern dominated by new home sales is rapidly shifting toward one where new and second-hand homes develop in tandem, with the property market entering a stock era. Under the Central Economic Work Conference requirement to 'control increments, destock inventory, and optimize supply,' multiple cities are also revitalizing existing housing stock through various means, promoting optimal allocation of existing housing resources and unlocking the value of stock housing. (CCTV Finance)

headlines.title: 回应急迫需求 各地持续优化住房公积金政策
headlines.summary: 近日，国务院常务会议审议通过《国务院关于修改〈住房公积金管理条例〉的决定（草案）》，明确指出要更好发挥住房公积金功能作用，拓宽提取和使用范围，扩大制度覆盖面，提升管理服务效能，更好满足居民多样化住房消费需求。对此，专家表示，这意味着住房公积金在促进住房消费、保障民生福祉方面的基础性作用将更加凸显。清华大学房地产研究中心主任吴璟表示，当前居民住房消费特征、房地产市场形势均发生明显变化，亟须对住房公积金制度作出相应调整。本轮改革既能降低缴存人的住房支出，有助于释放改善性和刚性住房需求，同时也稳定市场预期。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Responding to urgent needs, localities continue to optimize housing provident fund policies
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the State Council executive meeting approved the 'Draft Decision of the State Council on Amending the Housing Provident Fund Management Regulations,' explicitly stating that the role and functions of the housing provident fund should be better leveraged, extraction and use scope broadened, system coverage expanded, and management service efficiency improved, to better meet residents' diversified housing consumption needs. Experts noted this means the fundamental role of the housing provident fund in promoting housing consumption and safeguarding people's livelihoods will become more prominent. Wu Jing, director of Tsinghua University's Real Estate Research Center, said that residents' housing consumption characteristics and the property market situation have changed significantly, making corresponding adjustments to the housing provident fund system urgently necessary. This round of reform can lower contributors' housing expenditures, help release improvement and rigid housing demand, and stabilize market expectations. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 推动交通物流降本提质增效 浙江省政府出台重要意见
headlines.summary: 据浙江发布，浙江省政府近日印发《关于推进多式联运高质量发展的实施意见》。其中提出，到2030年，构建“一核四枢七轴三廊”多式联运发展格局，全省集装箱多式联运量近1000万标箱，沿海港口集装箱多式联运比例提升至14.5%，基本形成规模带动强、网络支撑强、联运组织强、服务保障强、发展质效强的多式联运高质量发展体系，全省社会物流总费用占GDP比率降至12.5%左右。到2035年，全面建成“联运高地”，海铁联运水平全国领先，江海河联运能力全国先进，空陆联运和公铁联运实现特色化发展，打造成为全国多式联运高质量发展的浙江样板。

headlines.title_en: Zhejiang provincial government issues important opinions to boost transport and logistics cost reduction and efficiency
headlines.summary_en: According to Zhejiang Release, the Zhejiang provincial government recently issued the 'Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Development of Multimodal Transport,' proposing that by 2030, a 'one core, four hubs, seven axes, three corridors' multimodal transport development pattern will be established, with provincial container multimodal transport volume reaching nearly 10 million TEUs, the proportion of coastal port container multimodal transport rising to 14.5%, and basically forming a high-quality multimodal transport development system with strong scale drive, strong network support, strong intermodal organization, strong service guarantee, and strong development quality, with the province's total social logistics cost ratio to GDP falling to around 12.5%. By 2035, a 'multimodal transport highland' will be fully built, with sea-rail transport leading nationally, river-sea and river-land transport capacity nationally advanced, air-land and road-rail transport achieving distinctive development, creating a Zhejiang model for national high-quality multimodal transport development.

headlines.summary: 据中国棉花协会，美方所谓“强迫劳动”的指控毫无事实与法理依据。此次制裁严重破坏了全球棉花产业链与供应链的稳定。棉花作为全球性的大宗商品，其产业链已高度国际化。美方此举损害了中国企业的合法权益。面对美方打压，中国棉花产业有信心、有能力应对挑战。中国拥有全球最完整的棉花及纺织产业链、超大规模的国内消费市场以及日益多元化的国际市场布局。我们呼吁广大国内棉花及纺织企业保持定力，坚定信心，加强合作，积极开拓多元化市场，增强供应链韧性，以高质量的产品和不可替代的产业优势打破外部封锁。

headlines.title_en: China Cotton Association issues statement opposing U.S. sanctions and suppression of Chinese cotton textile enterprises
headlines.summary_en: According to the China Cotton Association, the US side's so-called 'forced labor' accusations have no factual or legal basis. This sanction severely undermines the stability of the global cotton industry and supply chains. As a global commodity, cotton's industry chain is highly internationalized. This US action damages the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises. Facing US suppression, China's cotton industry has the confidence and capability to meet challenges. China possesses the world's most complete cotton and textile industry chain, a super-large domestic consumer market, and an increasingly diversified international market layout. We call on domestic cotton and textile enterprises to maintain composure, strengthen confidence, enhance cooperation, actively explore diversified markets, enhance supply chain resilience, and break external blockades with high-quality products and irreplaceable industrial advantages.

headlines.title: 古巴多省发生断电
headlines.summary: 古巴电力联盟8月1日通报，当地时间18时7分，该国马坦萨斯省至比那尔德里奥省一带电力系统发生断电。古巴电力联盟在社交媒体上表示，断电是线路跳闸所致。受美国制裁影响，古巴长期以来难以进口燃料及发电厂设备，发电厂设备老旧难更新，全国电力供应紧张。2024年10月以来，因电力设施故障、飓风侵袭等原因，古巴曾多次全国大停电。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Power Outages Across Multiple Provinces in Cuba
headlines.summary_en: Cuba's Electric Union reported on Aug. 1 that at 18:07 local time, a power outage hit the system from Matanzas Province to Pinar del Río Province. The union said on social media the outage was caused by a line trip. Due to U.S. sanctions, Cuba has long struggled to import fuel and power plant equipment, leaving aging plants hard to upgrade and the national power supply tight. Since October 2024, Cuba has suffered multiple nationwide blackouts due to equipment failures, hurricanes, and other causes. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: Chinese families turn to cash and cautious stock bets as real estate avenues narrow
headlines.summary:
Chinese families are fast retreating from real estate, with many holding large cash reserves now cautiously weighing stock investments, marking a stark contrast with South Korea, where retail investors are aggressively using leverage to fuel equity bets at home and abroad.

headlines.summary_zh: 中国家庭正快速撤离房地产市场，许多家庭持有大量现金，如今谨慎考虑股票投资，这与韩国形成鲜明对比——韩国散户投资者正积极利用杠杆在国内和海外市场进行股票押注。第一季度，房地产占家庭资产的比例降至52%。

headlines.title: 美计划本周末发动“猛烈轰炸”，伊朗：全面反击方案已就绪
headlines.summary: 美国国务院8月1日向中东地区美国公民发出广泛安全警告，建议其考虑撤离或做好迅速撤离准备。不过，美总统特朗普尚未下达最终行动命令。伊朗外交部则在同日发表声明，强调决心继续抵抗。据伊朗方面1日凌晨消息，一名伊朗高级安全官员透露，伊方已经制定了一套全面的反击方案，反击目标包括以色列的关键基础设施和中东地区的美国能源设施，随时可以启动这项方案。（央视）

headlines.title_en: U.S. Plans 'Intense Bombing' This Weekend; Iran: Full Counterattack Plan Ready
headlines.summary_en: The U.S. State Department on Aug. 1 issued a broad security warning to American citizens in the Middle East, advising them to consider leaving or prepare to leave quickly. President Trump, however, has not yet given a final order for action. Iran's Foreign Ministry, in a same-day statement, stressed its determination to continue resistance. According to Iranian sources early Aug. 1, a senior Iranian security official revealed that Tehran has prepared a comprehensive counterattack plan targeting Israeli critical infrastructure and U.S. energy facilities in the Middle East, ready to launch anytime. (CCTV)

headlines.title_en: China Cotton Association: Opposes U.S. sanctions and suppression of Chinese cotton textile enterprises
headlines.summary_en: The China Cotton Association issued a statement saying the US side's so-called 'forced labor' accusations have no factual or legal basis. China's cotton industry has always adhered to market-oriented and modernized development, with machine-picked cotton in Xinjiang now accounting for over 90%, and the entire industry chain from planting, harvesting to processing and textiles achieving high automation and scale. This sanction severely undermines the stability of the global cotton industry and supply chains. As a global commodity, cotton's industry chain is highly internationalized. This US action damages the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises.

headlines.title: 国常会最新部署！你的公积金 将有新变化
headlines.summary: 【国常会最新部署！你的公积金 将有新变化】国务院常务会议7月31日审议通过《国务院关于修改〈住房公积金管理条例〉的决定（草案）》。条例草案要求要更好发挥住房公积金功能作用，拓宽提取和使用范围，扩大制度覆盖面，提升管理服务效能，更好满足居民多样化住房消费需求。

headlines.title_en: State Council latest deployment! Your housing fund will see new changes
headlines.summary_en: [New deployment from the State Council executive meeting! Your housing provident fund will see new changes] The State Council executive meeting on July 31 reviewed and approved the "State Council Decision on Amending the Regulations on the Administration of Housing Provident Funds (Draft)." The draft requires better leveraging the role of housing provident funds, expanding the scope of withdrawals and uses, broadening system coverage, improving management service efficiency, and better meeting residents' diverse housing consumption needs.
